selection_rule.final_selection: highest validation objective within frozen training shortlist

holdout_status: retrospective holdout; not a claim of historically unseen research data
segment_basis: ongoing portfolios, NAV rebased to 1 including first daily return

train.portfolio_basis: ongoing holdings rebased to NAV 1; no added segment entry/exit cost

validation.portfolio_basis: ongoing holdings rebased to NAV 1; no added segment entry/exit cost

holdout.portfolio_basis: ongoing holdings rebased to NAV 1; no added segment entry/exit cost

full.portfolio_basis: ongoing holdings rebased to NAV 1; no added segment entry/exit cost

hindsight_best.label: full-period hindsight highest return; not validated

hindsight_objective_best.label: full-period hindsight objective winner; not validated

limitations: Historical temporal holdout is retrospective, not previously unseen live data.
A large parameter search creates selection bias; bootstrap is not its correction.
Segment results continue existing positions and are not fresh-start account simulations.
Return multiples are undefined when the benchmark cumulative return is nonpositive.
All results are observed-period returns without annualized projections.

holdout_bootstrap.benchmark_selection: highest training-period cumulative return among three benchmarks
holdout_bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive conditional uncertainty; not a multiple-testing correction
holdout_bootstrap.holdout_status: retrospective holdout; historical data were available to researcher

research_status: Additional adaptive research after earlier results; August-September is reused historical evaluation, not independent validation.

excluded_diagnostics.walk_forward: Legacy hardcoded switching surcharges; excluded from zero-cost experiment
